name: Carrion Defense Works Personal Decontamination Kit PDK-3
product_name: Carrion Defense Works Personal Decontamination Kit PDK-3
description: A compact kit for field decontamination after chemical, biological, or radiological exposure. The PDK-3 contains reactive decontamination wipes that neutralize chemical agents on contact, antibiotic skin wash for biological exposure, a radiation chelation injector that binds radioactive particles for excretion, and a set of disposable coveralls for clothing replacement. The kit provides 15 minutes of treatment — enough to decontaminate a single person from most common CBRN threats if applied within the first 10 minutes of exposure.

specifications.treatment window: Most effective within 10 minutes of exposure

story_hooks: A PDK-3's chemical wipes failed to neutralize an unknown agent — the compound is not in Carrion's database and the decontamination protocol needs to be developed from scratch while the clock ticks.

PDK-3 kits have been distributed with expired chelation injectors that provide no radiation protection — whoever replaced the injectors wanted exposed individuals to believe they were safe when they were not.
